scope: Parent Gifts01–02 and Settle Adversary01–02 original-detail review for continuity, gaze, anatomy, plate contact and comparison/outcome source boundaries.
globalConditions: Technical review is not owner approval or final browser acceptance.
Imagined teaching illustrations, not divine portraits or identified historical family/legal incidents.

entries.alt: A child extends an open hand beside a loaf of bread on a table while a bearded father in blue meets the child's gaze.
entries.caption: Jesus asks which parent would give a child a stone when asked for bread. This imagined exchange pictures the ordinary care behind His comparison.
entries.findings: Clear mutual eye contact, natural child proportions and restrained attentive expressions. Child open palm and father's resting hands plausible. Bread on plate/table, not falsely described transferred. Photographic skin/cloth, distinct father and child.
conditions: Father is an ordinary fictional parent, not a portrait of Heavenly Father or Jesus.
No stone is visible and no completed bread handoff claimed.

entries.recommendedTitle: A good gift for the child
entries.alt: The same father and child hold a plate bearing a cooked fish between them while looking into each other's eyes.
entries.caption: Jesus contrasts giving a child fish with offering a serpent, and speaks of parents giving good gifts. He then directs His listeners to the Heavenly Father's willingness to give the Holy Spirit to those who ask.
entries.findings: Father's thinning curls/full beard/blue tunic/cream scarf and child's short brown waves/striped garment continue01. Reciprocal gaze credible. Both sets of hands contact and support dish without fused fingers; cooked fish lies on plate. Photographic textures and natural warmth.
conditions: Human parent remains a comparison, not a divine likeness.
The image shows shared plate support, not proof of completed transfer or eating; exact food preparation is artistic.

entries.alt: An older balding man in ochre and a younger dark-haired man in cream and charcoal walk together on a stone path, facing one another as the older man gestures.
entries.caption: Jesus urges His listener to come to agreement with an adversary quickly while still on the way. The conversation pictures that opportunity, without showing whether the two reach a settlement.
entries.findings: Distinct clean-shaven balding older man/ochre/striped mantle and younger short dark hair/beard/cream/charcoal. Mutual gaze, open palm, robe grip, hanging hands and walking feet plausible. Serious conversation without threat or staged reconciliation; natural photographic skin/cloth.
conditions: Do not claim agreement, forgiveness, a handshake, guilt or legal resolution.
Unnamed illustrative adversaries, not recorded historical individuals or a specific case.

entries.alt: The same two men approach stone steps leading to a seated official and two guards under a columned portico.
entries.caption: Jesus counsels making an effort to settle with an adversary before reaching the magistrate. Their approach illustrates the urgency of that warning, not a completed hearing or conviction.
entries.findings: Both figures preserve01 faces in profile, hair and clothing. Walking soles and feet, visible hand and gestures credible; their attention shifts toward destination. Distant official/guards provide plausible illustrative context without legible documents or verdict. Photographic masonry and garments.
conditions: No arrest, conviction, penalty, paid debt or settlement established.
Portico, guards and seated official are artistic staging; not authenticated court architecture or a named magistrate.
